subject: general
question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

While he was running along the garden path, he has tripped over a big stone.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'he has tripped'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• 
 
The simple past tense is used to describe an action or event that occurred and was completed at a specific time in the past. For example, "he ran" or "he tripped" are in the simple past tense.
